update_vs_toolchain: run the vs_toolchain update command to download and configure the Visual Studio toolchain for gyp
set_environment_and_get_runtime_dll_dirs: run SetEnvironmentAndGetRuntimeDllDirs to configure environment variables for the depot_tools VS toolchain and get runtime DLL directories
find_depot_tools: run FindDepotTools to locate the depot_tools directory by searching PATH for gclient.py
get_visual_studio_version: run GetVisualStudioVersion to retrieve the configured GYP_MSVS_VERSION or default toolchain version 2015
get_desired_vs_toolchain_hashes: run _GetDesiredVsToolchainHashes to get the SHA1 hashes for the desired VS 2015 or 2017 toolchain
